title: Crypto investors cry foul as Finblox converts deposits to tokens to offset 3AC losses
notes: Detailed contemporaneous reporting documents the FBX debt-conversion process, several customers who said they recovered deposits in full, and CEO Peter Hoang's statement that Finblox had run a test buyback scheme for some users. It also documents customers reporting unresolved losses. CYA therefore treats this as evidence of partial/selective recovery, not universal repayment.

title: Finblox shutters three years after losing millions of dollars worth of customer deposits
notes: Later reporting at platform closure confirms that customer funds had been converted into FBX and that customers continued to report unrecovered losses. This supports a mixed/partial outcome and argues against treating earlier selective recoveries as universal completion.
